# contoso — Context

## Stack
Clouds: Azure only; one Entra tenant contoso.onmicrosoft.com
IaC + state: Terraform 1.9 / azurerm 4.x; state in sttfstateprd001 (rg-tfstate-prd)
Source + CI/CD: Azure DevOps Repos + Pipelines (project "platform")
Governed solutions: every pipeline must extend the templates in ADO repo pipeline-templates (v4); IaC modules from repo platform-iac/modules only
Monitoring/SIEM: Microsoft Sentinel on law-sec-prd-eus2; Azure Monitor
Security tools: Wiz (CSPM + IaC scanning in PRs); Checkov in pipeline-templates
Scanners + what they block: Checkov blocks Critical/High; Wiz PR scan blocks Critical; Azure Policy denies public network access on new PaaS (initiative "contoso-guardrails")
AI tools approved here: Claude Code

## Access from this machine
az CLI logged in as reader (read-only). I run anything that writes.

## Where commands run
Write commands: jump host vm-jump-prd-01, Windows PowerShell 5.1 with Az modules; paste only (no file copy to or from it).

## Environments
Mgmt groups: contoso > platform / landingzones (corp, online) / sandbox
Subs: sub-connectivity, sub-management, sub-prd-corp, sub-np-corp
AMER regions: East US 2 (primary), Central US (DR pair)
Network: hub-spoke; Azure Firewall Premium in vnet-hub-eus2; ExpressRoute to on-prem (10.0.0.0/8); spokes from 10.40.0.0/14

## Conventions
Naming: CAF <type>-<workload>-<env>-<region>-<nnn>; tags owner, costcenter, env (policy deny)
PR rules: 1 reviewer, Checkov + Wiz must pass, ticket in PR title

## Process
Change process: ServiceNow CHG; prod needs CAB (Tue/Thu); emergency via on-call manager
Docs go to: Confluence space PLAT
Work tracking: Azure DevOps Boards, org contoso, project platform, Agile process (Epic > Feature > User Story > Task); area platformsecurity; iteration platform6Sprint 21; story points; DoD: PR merged, change record, monitoring in place. CLI: az boards (read-only for the agent).

## People
Priya — network lead
Marcus — security architect (Sentinel, Wiz, policy exceptions)
